# Vox 2.0.9

Maintenance & performance release following 2.0.8.

## What's Changed

- **Tidal Max Engine**: Official PKCE login, hi-res resolver, Innertube fallback, and Audiophile tone stage.
- **Player Studio & Visuals**: Player Studio with custom skins, live three-bar playing indicator, and Live Island overlay refinements.
- **Lyrics & Share**: Lyric signatures, carousel export, verse-tagged copy, and two-mode artwork card.
- **Performance & Diagnostics**: Storage and diagnostics screens, battery/burn-in guards, and Coil 3 island image loading fixes.
- **Signing & Compatibility**: Verified v1 + v2 APK signature schemes for complete support across modern and legacy OEM Android devices (ColorOS / Oppo, etc.).
